column2: Sorry, I'm cleaning the bath right now. Could you come back a little later?
Hmm~, I feel like somethin' like this happened before... or maybe not...
Right then, let's go hunt for some clothes!
We still cannot forgive you...
If we should ever meet again, then......
...Suit yourself.
I hear some rare items are up for auction today...
I can't wait...
An empire that sank into the sea in a single night... I wonder if it really existed?
They say the Lost Continent once had an empire with an advanced civilization.
There are rumors that people from that continent survive even now...
Apparently some of the continent's people had mysterious powers.
They say they could breathe souls into dolls and control them at will...
HP restored!!
Abstract art, huh... I don't get this kinda stuff.
Huh? What's this a picture of?
Hmm... Abstract art, huh.
Abstract art is difficult to interpret, isn't it?
This kind of thing isn't really for me.
What's this, a weird-lookin' picture~ I could paint better'n this!
...An inscrutable painting.
No peeking!!
Now then, just the skirt left...
Okay, this one next.
That oughta brighten things up a little...
Too damn dark to see anything...
Just a plain landscape painting? Kinda dull.
Now, a picture like this I can understand~
A painting of plain scenery is just boring.
A landscape painting... How lovely.
I prefer pictures like this.
What, a borin' picture~ There ain't no twist to it at all!!
I prefer Japanese painting to Western landscapes.
Whoa, she's quite the looker.
Wow, what a pretty lady~~~ I really like this one!
Hmm, a portrait...
A portrait... Quite a fine one, isn't it?
...Who's this?
Whoa, what a beauty! Wanna come be my bride?
...I do not care for this kind of painting.
...Think they'd let me have one of these?
What is this? Is it expensive??
Art that looks like it cost a fortune...
Everything here looks expensive.
Madoka's mansion had stuff like this too...
Whoa, it's all fancy high-class stuff!
...Think they'd give me one?
...A fine piece.
It says 'Storeroom.'
It says 'Study.'
It says 'Great Hall.'
It says 'Kitchen.'
It says 'Master Bedroom.'
It says 'Costume Room.'
It says 'Bedroom.'
It says 'Bathroom.'
It says 'Guest Room.'
Man, we didn't meet a single swimsuit babe or yukata babe...
What'd we even go to that island for...
Hey, Ban-chan... Where do you think Al-kun went?
Who knows...
Anyway, Ginji, since when have those things been running loose in this town?
Huh?!
Those are the guys from the underground cave! Why are they in the middle of town?!
...Looks like somebody's about to explain all that for us.
Ginji, take a look at that big screen over there.
Hear me, my dear citizens of Japan...
That guy, he's the one from before...
My name is Jend... I am the king who rules the 'Wandering People' clan.
We once lived on the 'Lost Continent,' which sank into the sea in a single night...
The Lost Continent... That's what Clayman-san was talking about...
Since losing our homeland, we have journeyed on in search of a land to settle.
But nowhere was there a land that would accept us.
After long years of wandering, we have at last reached this conclusion.
If we have no place of our own, we shall take one from those who do.
That it is only natural for the strong to take from the weak!
But that doesn't mean you can do something like this...
From this moment on, Shinjuku is the nation of our clan, the Wandering People.
You who were once the people of a nation called Japan,
kneel before me, and bless the birth of a new nation!!
Quit screwing around! Save the sleep-talk for when you're asleep!!
Ban-chan! Just now, I saw Al-kun behind that guy...
Kyaaaaaaaah!!
?! What was that?
It came from nearby! Let's go see!!
A girl's being attacked! We've gotta help her!!
Right! Let's go, Ginji!!
I was in a foul mood anyway, so that hit the spot...
Huh, you're the girl from the other day... Mitchan, right?
Waaah, I was so scared!!
The brat who lost her hairpin, huh. Brings back bad memories of working for free...
Mitchan, it's dangerous to be out here all by yourself!
We've gotta get you back to your mom, quick!
But me and Mommy promised to meet at the park...
and there were lots of scary people...
I see... So those guys...
Can't I ever see Mommy again? Can't I ever go to the park again?
Nooo, Mommyyy!!
Don't cry. If it's the park, we'll take it back for you!
Hey, Ginji! How many times do I have to tell you?!
We don't do jobs that don't pay...
Money? ...Oh, I know! Mitchan has money!!
What's this...? A foreign coin?
This money, Big Brother Al gave it to me!
He said if I asked you big brothers with this, you'd make my wish come true.
...Listen, kid. We're not some genie in a lamp.
But Ban-chan, this... it's bronze money! The most valuable money in Al-kun's country...
...Ban-chan.
...Fine. I'll hang on to this as a down payment.
But in exchange, Al's gonna pay us the rest of the money in full.
Ban-chan, does that mean...
GetBackers! This job... consider it done!!
Wait for us, Mitchan! We'll take this town back for sure!
Oh, Ban-san and Ginji-san! Welcome back!!
Listen, something terrible happened while you two were gone!
Yeah, we know.
Paul, you know where the boss of those creeps outside is holed up?
Alpha Tower.
Alpha Tower, the skyscraper? But isn't that still under construction...?
Under construction means thin security. That's exactly why they took it so easily.
...Right. Now that we know where it is, let's get going.
Hey, you two...
Huh?
Make sure you pay your tab.
Don't worry, we'll be back.
...Probably.
Well, we're off!!
Ban-san and Ginji-san will come back safe, won't they?
Of course. Those two are the kind you couldn't kill if you tried...
So this is Alpha Tower...
Hey, Ban-chan... Do you think Al-kun's up there too?
Yeah, probably.
That kid did a whole lot for us... He's not getting off easy.
So we gotta catch him fast and make him quit this stupid stuff.
Get fired up, Ginjiii!
Yeah, you're right! Let's give it our all, Ban-chan!!
Still, building something this stupidly tall...
Think about the guys who have to climb it.
So how's it look over there? Think it'll run?
Hmm, no good. It won't move~...
No good?
You know how many floors this place has? 99!
No way... We're not walking all the way up to floor 99, are we...?
...Nah. From the looks of it, the power's just off.
If we just turn the power on in the switch room, it oughta work.
That's Ban-chan for you!!
But where would a switch room even be?
That's what we're gonna go find out!
...Ah, figured.
Found the switch room! Ginji, coming in!!
It's locked... It's locked! Waaah! So it's the stairs after all...?!
Can't be helped. Guess the great Ban Mido'll just have to force it open...
N-no way! If you do it, Ban-chan, you'll break the machines inside too!
Let's look for the key!!
...Tch, what a pain.
It can't be helped, Ban-chan!
(Phew, that was close~...)
Hey hey, Ban-chan, why don't we just walk up to floor 99 like this?
I'm kinda starting to have fun!
Hey, Ginji, quit scampering around.
This place is under construction. The scaffolding could give way at any moment.
What? You run into a monster or something?
Well, well... Long time no see.
Kyoji Kagami-san...!
Well, I'll be... A real monster showed up.
...What's a resident of the Tower doing in a place like this?
Things down in the world below looked like they were getting interesting...
So I came to observe.
Tch. Still as irritating as ever, you bastard.
Then why not try beating me?
If you two get serious, you might just be able to beat me, you know?
If you're lucky, that is... right?
Interesting! Bring it on!!
Then let us begin.
Hey, I've been waiting for you.
You... If you're here, you must be observing those things, huh?
That's right... The 'Wandering People,' that is.
Looks like you two have finally noticed them too, hm?
Tch. Pisses me off every damn time, you bastard.
Then why not try beating me?
If you two get serious, you might just be able to beat me, you know?
If you're lucky, that is... right?
Interesting! Bring it on!!
Then let us begin.
